verdict.rationale: Jeeves is a SaaS finance platform that holds customer financial data and offers AI-facing features such as an MCP server and smart invoice scanning, so a policy or control against using that data for AI training is a fair question. The evidence pack contains nothing about AI training opt-outs, data-use policies, or model-training exclusions. The security items (MFA, mTLS/OAuth) are adjacent controls and do not address this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
